title: WorkItemReport
description: How a work item round ends (work-items.md §3.4). The daemon sends this schema as the round's responseFormat and reads the round's reply against it; a reply that does not conform is recorded as a blocked report with reason report_unreadable. Only keywords the structured-output validator enforces are used.

status.description: ready: the work is done. progress: it moved and goes on when something new arrives. waiting: nothing can happen until an outside event. blocked: a person is needed. failed: it cannot be done. dropped: it is no longer wanted.

summary.description: What the round did and where the work stands, for the person who asked.

attention.description: The one question a person must answer for the work to go on.
